en: An illustrated postcard featuring three children. One child is dressed in a military uniform with medals and a feathered hat, another child is wearing traditional regional costume with a large bow headdress, and the third child is dressed in a sailor-style outfit. The illustration has a soft, early 20th-century style, and the children appear to be playfully interacting. The card is signed by the artist in the bottom right corner.
